newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Visco accuses Buba of causing unemployment.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Visco accuses Buba of causing unemployment.

text.p: Italian Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco on Thursday said Germany's central bank had helped push up unemployment across Europe.
"The Bundesbank with its policies has created unemployment in Germany and the rest of Europe," Visco told a parliamentary budget commission.
Visco added that the Bank of Italy's own tight monetary policy was restricting economic activity.
"I understand the Bank of Italy's caution...but even this monetary policy has had an impact on growth," he said.
Visco has been a critic of Germany's firm line over strict adherence to the tough economic criteria laid down for aspiring members of the single European currency.

"The fanaticism for accountancy, that until now has strongly conditioned the path to monetary union, has been cracked," Visco said earlier this week after the French government questioned a stability pact designed to enforce fiscal restraint in Europe. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
